teal Module: eDISH / mDISH / cholestatic screening plot

Source: R/tm_g_edish.R
tm_g_edish.Rd

teal Module: eDISH / mDISH / cholestatic screening plot

Usage

tm_g_edish(
  label = "eDISH plot",
  adsl_name = "ADSL",
  adlb_name = "ADLB",
  arm_var = teal.picks::variables(choices = c("TRT01A", "TRT01P", "ARM", "SEX", "RACE",
    "COUNTRY"), selected = "TRT01A", multiple = FALSE),
  population_var = teal.picks::variables(choices = c("SAFFL", "ITTFL"), selected =
    "SAFFL", multiple = FALSE),
  population_value = "Y",
  window_days = 14,
  exclude_alp = TRUE,
  compare = c(">=", ">"),
  which = c("edish", "mdish", "cholestatic"),
  color_by = c("arm", "quadrant"),
  facet = FALSE,
  annotate_quadrants = TRUE,
  mark_potential = TRUE,
  log_axes = TRUE,
  group_vars = NULL,
  population_choices = NULL
)

Arguments

label

Module label.

adsl_name

ADSL dataset name in teal_data.

adlb_name

ADLB dataset name.

arm_var

(teal.picks::variables())
Treatment or grouping column on ADSL. multiple must be FALSE. The default selection is TRT01A. The badge shows the column name. The menu shows that column's label from the data.

population_var

(teal.picks::variables())
Population flag column on ADSL. multiple must be FALSE. The default selection is SAFFL. A length-1 character string is deprecated and still accepted as the selected flag.

population_value

Population flag value to keep. Not shown in the UI.

window_days

Default concurrent window.

exclude_alp

Default ALP exclusion.

compare

Default threshold operator, ">=" or ">".

which

"edish", "mdish", or "cholestatic".

color_by

"arm" or "quadrant".

facet

Default faceting.

annotate_quadrants

Default corner labels.

mark_potential

Default red-circle overlay.

log_axes

Default log-axis setting.

group_vars

Named character vector of treatment columns, such as c("Actual Treatment" = "TRT01A"). Still accepted. Converted with lifecycle::deprecate_warn() to teal.picks::variables(choices, selected, multiple = FALSE). Prefer arm_var.

population_choices

Named character vector of population flag columns. Still accepted and converted the same way. Prefer population_var.

Value

A teal module object.

Examples

synth <- make_synthetic_hyslaw_data(n_extra = 0L, seed = 1L)
data <- teal.data::teal_data(ADSL = synth$ADSL, ADLB = synth$ADLB)
app <- teal::init(
  data = data,
  modules = teal::modules(
    tm_g_edish(
      arm_var = teal.picks::variables(
        choices = c("TRT01A", "SEX", "RACE", "COUNTRY"),
        selected = "TRT01A",
        multiple = FALSE
      ),
      population_var = teal.picks::variables(
        choices = c("SAFFL", "ITTFL"),
        selected = "SAFFL",
        multiple = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
)
#> Registered S3 method overwritten by 'teal':
#>   method        from      
#>   c.teal_slices teal.slice
if (interactive()) {
  shiny::shinyApp(app$ui, app$server)
}
